name: doc-sunset-notice
description: Writes a Feature Sunset Notice with the internal decision note and the customer notice covering what is going, why, when, what replaces it, migration steps and a support FAQ. Use for "run doc-sunset-notice", "sunset notice", "deprecate a feature", "retire a feature customers still use", "deprecation announcement", "end of life notice", "migration steps for customers", "support FAQ for a removal", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
